input.claim_text: On 3 September 2023 I woke up to find my front fence and letterbox spray painted with some kind of symbol, and one of the timber palings had been kicked in. I'm not sure exactly when it happened overnight, and I didn't hear anything, but it definitely wasn't like that when I went to bed. My policy number is HM-773245 and I'd guess it'll cost around $850 to repaint and replace the paling.

output.cause: unknown vandalism on front fence and letterbox

input.query: Are fences and letterboxes included in the definition of Insured Property / Home for building cover purposes?

output.answer:

None of the excerpts include the actual definition of "Home" or "Insured Property" that would confirm whether fences and letterboxes are specifically included (the PDS notes this definition is set out on pages 23–26, which are not among the provided excerpts) [RAA Contents PDS, page 21].

To answer definitively, the definitions on pages 23–26 of the RAA Contents PDS would need to be reviewed.
